maker.source: Synthetic: a class, not a model — the seed's “Wedge scanner (class)” (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2)

interface.source: Synthetic: the class is the keyboard wedge, whose key presses the active layout re-maps (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §5)

prefix.source: Synthetic: no prefix, as the lab configures every scanner (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.4)

inter_key_ms.source: Synthetic: swept from 0 ms to 60 ms, twice §5's 30 ms burst threshold, so both sides of it run under the US and Arabic (101) host layouts (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §5, §6b.2)

arabic_keyboard_countries.source: Synthetic: a scanner left on its default US layout, the case 1.11.6b decodes by physical key (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §5)

alt_or_keypad_emulation.source: Synthetic: no device-side answer to the layout, so the decoding alone must carry it (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §5)

reads_2d.source: Synthetic: the class types the fiscal QR's value as well as linear codes (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §5)

symbologies.source: Synthetic: Code 128 and QR values carry Latin letters the Arabic layout re-maps, and digit-only EAN survives it (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §5)
